$comment: Input for scripts/terrain/bern.mjs (npm run terrain:bern): the About terrain, a 12 × 9 km window around the zero point of the Swiss coordinate system that also holds the Aare through Bern, Ittigen and the Bantiger (each at least 1 km inside). Outputs land in public/terrain/bern/.
label: Bern

zeroPoint.label: Zero point of LV95: the old observatory in Bern (swisstopo)

$focus: What the field and the posters frame (object-position): the zero point. On a wide screen the whole window shows; on a phone the part around the zero point.

cityFacts.$comment: Stadt Bern statistics (data from swisstopo), used as labels and sanity checks of the DEM.

placeholder.$comment: Only when the elevation download fails: seeded low-relief noise, flagged as a placeholder everywhere.
